summary: Hunter separated from their party in the Bears Ears area north of Hayden due to darkness and snow, ~8 p.m. — 30 minutes after the Dunckley Pass search wrapped; made a 911 call with coordinates before their phone died; found frigid and unable to walk, packaged in a hypothermia wrap and hauled on a wheeled litter nearly 1,500 feet back up the hill through 8 inches of snow to a waiting ambulance.
location: Bears Ears area north of Hayden
responding_agency: Routt County Search and Rescue; Routt County Sheriff's Office; Moffat County Sheriff's Office; Moffat County Search and Rescue; Memorial Regional Health EMS
notes: Freshness sweep run 33: Steamboat Pilot via operanewsapp mirror (published 2026-10-20) + KZYR Zephyr Press Oct-16 newscast; second of three RCSAR pages within 14 hours during first rifle season.
